verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI reviews run automatically on every new PR in the selected repositories. The only documented control over where they run is choosing specific repos or the whole org. Comment exclusions limit when the agent leaves comments, not when reviews are triggered. Disabling AI org-wide requires emailing support. missing for 10: skipping draft PRs, on-demand/manual review triggering (e.g., via comment or command), branch-based filters, label-based filters, independent corroboration.
